t: Whisper large-v3 (OpenAI) — the open STT standard
title: Whisper large-v3 (OpenAI) — the open STT standard
description: Whisper large-v3 is the reference open speech-recognition model: 1.5B parameters trained on 5 million hours of audio, transcribing 99 languages with word timestamps and English translation. It runs via the whisper CLI, faster-whisper, or transformers, and its API form powers countless transcription products. Every open STT model is still benchmarked against it.

demo.code:
from transformers import pipeline
asr = pipeline("automatic-speech-recognition", model="openai/whisper-large-v3")
out = asr("interview.mp3", return_timestamps=True)
print(out["text"][:300])

provenance: Public model cards, provider documentation, and open model repository metadata.

title: Whisper large-v3-turbo (OpenAI) — fast open STT
description: Whisper large-v3-turbo distills the large-v3 decoder from 32 layers to 4, making transcription roughly 8x faster with minimal accuracy loss. For batch transcription pipelines where throughput matters, turbo is the practical default — same 99 languages, far less GPU time.

demo.code:
import whisper
model = whisper.load_model("turbo")
print(model.transcribe("lecture.mp3")["text"][:300])

provenance: Public model cards, provider documentation, and open model repository metadata.

title: Deepgram Nova-3 (Deepgram) — streaming STT API
description: Deepgram's Nova-3 is the low-latency streaming transcription API: interim results in hundreds of milliseconds, smart formatting (numbers, dates), and keyword boosting for domain terms. It is the 'live captions that keep up' choice for meetings, contact centers, and voice agents.

demo.code:
from deepgram import DeepgramClient
from deepgram.core.events import EventType
# streaming: open a websocket, send mic chunks, receive interim transcripts
print("See Deepgram live-transcription docs for the websocket recipe.")
demo.notes: Pattern note — full recipe in Deepgram docs.

provenance: Public model cards, provider documentation, and open model repository metadata.

title: AssemblyAI Universal-2 (AssemblyAI) — STT with understanding
description: AssemblyAI's Universal-2 bundles transcription with speaker diarization, sentiment, entity detection, and summarization in one API call. For 'transcribe this call and tell me what mattered,' it replaces a whole pipeline with one request.

demo.code:
import assemblyai as aai
aai.settings.api_key = "AAI_KEY"
transcript = aai.Transcriber().transcribe("call.mp3",
    config=aai.TranscriptionConfig(speaker_labels=True, summarization=True))
print(transcript.summary)

provenance: Public model cards, provider documentation, and open model repository metadata.

title: Parakeet-TDT 1.1B (NVIDIA) — fast open STT
description: NVIDIA's Parakeet-TDT is the speed king of open STT: a 1.1B transducer model that transcribes faster than real-time on a single GPU with excellent English accuracy, under CC-BY-4.0. For self-hosted English transcription at scale, it beats Whisper on throughput.

demo.code:
import nemo.collections.asr as nemo_asr
asr = nemo_asr.models.ASRModel.from_pretrained("nvidia/parakeet-tdt-1.1b")
print(asr.transcribe(["podcast.wav"]))

provenance: Public model cards, provider documentation, and open model repository metadata.

title: wav2vec 2.0 (Meta) — self-supervised speech pioneer
description: wav2vec 2.0 pioneered self-supervised speech learning: pre-train on raw audio, fine-tune on 10 minutes of labels, get a working recognizer. The large-960h checkpoint remains the teaching-lab standard, and its XLSR siblings cover 128 languages. It is the model that made low-resource STT practical.

demo.code:
from transformers import pipeline
asr = pipeline("automatic-speech-recognition", model="facebook/wav2vec2-large-960h")
print(asr("clip.wav")["text"])

provenance: Public model cards, provider documentation, and open model repository metadata.

title: WhisperX (open) — word-perfect alignment
description: WhisperX wraps Whisper with VAD cutoffs and wav2vec2 forced alignment to produce word-level timestamps accurate enough for professional subtitling, plus speaker diarization hooks. When subtitles must land on the exact frame, this is the open pipeline.

demo.code:
# pip install whisperx
import whisperx
model = whisperx.load_model("large-v3")
result = model.transcribe("video.mp3")
aligned = whisperx.align(result["segments"], whisperx.load_align_model("en")[0], "en", "video.mp3")
print(aligned["word_segments"][:5])

provenance: Public model cards, provider documentation, and open model repository metadata.

title: pyannote speaker-diarization-3.1 — who spoke when
description: pyannote's diarization pipeline is the research standard for 'who spoke when': segmentation, embedding, clustering — with 3.1 cutting error rates substantially. It slots into any transcription stack to attach speaker labels to Whisper output.

demo.code:
from pyannote.audio import Pipeline
pipe = Pipeline.from_pretrained("pyannote/speaker-diarization-3.1")
for turn, _, spk in pipe("meeting.wav").itertracks(yield_label=True):
    print(f"{turn.start:.1f}s {spk}")
demo.notes: Real pyannote pattern (HF token for gated weights).

provenance: Public model cards, provider documentation, and open model repository metadata.

t: ElevenLabs Eleven v3 — most natural TTS API
title: ElevenLabs Eleven v3 — most natural TTS API
description: Eleven v3 is the current quality bar for API text-to-speech: emotive, natural prosody, 70+ languages, and voice cloning from short samples with consent checks. It powers audiobooks, video dubbing, and voice agents where the voice itself is the product.

demo.code:
from elevenlabs import ElevenLabs
client = ElevenLabs(api_key="EL_KEY")
audio = client.text_to_speech.convert(voice_id="narrator", model_id="eleven_v3",
    text="The archive holds a million voices.")
open("out.mp3", "wb").write(b"".join(audio))

provenance: Public model cards, provider documentation, and open model repository metadata.

title: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts — simple steerable TTS
description: OpenAI's TTS endpoint turns text into speech with simple voice presets and instruction-based steering ('speak like a cheerful pirate'). It is the zero-friction choice inside OpenAI-centric stacks: one API key for chat and voice alike.

demo.code:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI()
with client.audio.speech.with_streaming_response.create(
        model="gpt-4o-mini-tts", voice="coral",
        input="Welcome to the archive.") as r:
    r.stream_to_file("welcome.mp3")

title: XTTS v2 (Coqui) — open multilingual cloning
description: XTTS v2 clones any voice from ~6 seconds of audio across 16 languages — the open multilingual cloning standard. It runs locally, speaks with emotion control, and anchors countless open dubbing projects.

demo.code:
from TTS.api import TTS
tts = TTS("tts_models/multilingual/multi-dataset/xtts_v2", gpu=True)
tts.tts_to_file("Bonjour le monde.", speaker_wav="sample.wav", language="fr", file_path="out.wav")
# Only clone voices you own or have written consent for.
demo.notes: Real Coqui TTS pattern with the consent rule.

t: Silero VAD — open voice activity detection
title: Silero VAD — open voice activity detection
description: Silero VAD is the tiny open model that knows when someone is speaking: 2MB, real-time, MIT-licensed. It gates every serious voice pipeline — no transcription, no agent turn-taking, without it.

demo.code:
import torch
model, utils = torch.hub.load("snakers4/silero-vad", "silero_vad")
(get_ts, _, _, _, _) = utils
wav = torch.randn(16000 * 5)  # your 16kHz audio here
print(get_ts(wav, model, threshold=0.5, sampling_rate=16000))

title: ECAPA-TDNN (SpeechBrain) — open speaker recognition
description: ECAPA-TDNN embeddings identify WHO is speaking from seconds of audio — the open standard for speaker verification and clustering, via SpeechBrain's VoxCeleb-trained checkpoint.

demo.code:
from speechbrain.inference import EncoderClassifier
clf = EncoderClassifier.from_hparams(source="speechbrain/spkrec-ecapa-voxceleb")
emb1 = clf.encode_batch("alice.wav"); emb2 = clf.encode_batch("bob.wav")
print("same speaker score:", (emb1 * emb2).sum().item())
